G2196.def:
**Ζαρά**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. זֶרַח, [[Gen.38.30|Gen.38:30]]),
**Zerah, an ancestor of Jesus**: [[Mat.1.3|Mat.1:3]]†
(AS)

G2147.def:
**εὑρίσκω**,
[in LXX chiefly for מצא, also for נשׂג hi., etc. ;]
**to find**, **with or without previous search**: absol., opposite to ζητέω, [[Mat.7.7|Mat.7:7]], 8 [[Luk.11.9, 10|Luk.11:9, 10]]; with accusative, [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[Mrk.1.37|Mrk.1:37]], [[Act.13.22|Act.13:22]], [[2Ti.1.17|2Ti.1:17]], al.; pass., οὐχ εὑ., of disappearance, [[Heb.11.5|Heb.11:5]], [[Rev.16.20|Rev.16:20]], al.; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται (for conjectures as to the meaning of this reading, see Mayor, _ICC_, in l.), [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]], WH, R, mg. Metaphorical, **to find, find out** by inquiry, **learn, discover**: [[Luk.19.48|Luk.19:48]], [[Act.4.21|Act.4:21]]; αἰτίαν, [[Jhn.18.38|Jhn.18:38]], [[Act.13.28|Act.13:28]], al.; pass., [[Mat.1.18|Mat.1:18]], [[Luk.17.18|Luk.17:18]], [[Rom.7.10|Rom.7:10]], [[1Co.4.2|1Co.4:2]], [[Gal.2.17|Gal.2:17]], [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]], [[Rev.5.4|Rev.5:4]], al.; of attaining to the knowledge of God, εὑ. θεόν, [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]] pass., [[Rom.10.20|Rom.10:20]] (LXX). Mid., **to find for oneself, gain, procure, obtain**: with accusative of thing(s), λύτρωσιν, [[Heb.9.12|Heb.9:12]] act. in same sense (so cl. poets, but not in Attic prose), [[Mat.10.39; 11.29|Mat.10:39 11:29]], [[Luk.1.30|Luk.1:30]], [[Act.7.46|Act.7:46]], [[2Ti.1.18|2Ti.1:18]], al. (cf. ἀν-ευρίσκω).
(AS)

G2117.def:
**εὐθύς**, -εῖα, -ύ
[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁר ;]
1. **straight, direct**: τρίβοι, [[Mat.3.3|Mat.3:3]], [[Mrk.1.3|Mrk.1:3]], [[Luk.3.4|Luk.3:4]]" (LXX) ; εἰς εὐθειας, (sc. ὁδούς), [[Luk.3.5|Luk.3:5]] εὐ. ὐδός, figuratively, [[Act.13.10|Act.13:10]], [[2Pe.2.15|2Pe.2:15]]; as (Proper name) of a street, [[Act.9.11|Act.9:11]]
2. **In moral sense, straightforward, right**: καρδία, [[Act.8.21|Act.8:21]] (cf. [[Psa.7.11; 32.11|Psa.7:11 32:11]], al.).†
εὐθύς,
_adv._, [in LXX (more frequently than εὐθέως) chiefly for יָשַׁר ;]
**= εὐθέως, straightway, directly**: [[Mat.3.16; 13.20-21; 14.27; 21.2-3; 26.74|Mat.3:16 13:20-21 14:27 21:2-3 26:74]], [[Luk.6.49|Luk.6:49]], [[Jhn.13.30, 32; 19.34|Jhn.13:30, 32 19:34]], [[Act.10.16, 42|Act.10:16, 42]] times in _Mk._†
(AS)

G2191.def:
**ἔχιδνα**, -ης, ἡ
[in OT (Aq.), [[Isa.59.5|Isa.59:5]] * ;]
**a viper**: [[Act.28.3|Act.28:3]] metaphorically, γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, [[Mat.3.7; 12.34; 23.33|Mat.3:7 12:34 23:33]], [[Luk.3.7|Luk.3:7]].†
(AS)

G2112.def:
**εὐθέως **
_adv._ (εὐθύς), [in LXX: [[Job.5.3|Job.5:3]] (פִּתְאוֹם), [[Wis.5.12|Wis.5:12]], [[1Ma.11.12|1Ma.11:12]], al. ;]
**straightway, at once, directly**: [[Gal.1.16|Gal.1:16]], [[Jas.1.24|Jas.1:24]], [[3Jn.14|3Jn.14]] (cf. Dalman, _Words_, 28 f.), [[Rev.4.2|Rev.4:2]], and frequently in Mt, Lk, Jo, Ac (in Mk, εὐθύς), which see)
(AS)

G2198.def:
**ζάω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for חיה (most frequently ptcp., ζῶν, inf., ζῆν, for חַי ;]
1. prop., **to live, be alive** (see Syn., see word βίος; in cl. usually of animal life, but sometimes of plants, as Arist., _Eth. N_, i, 7, 12): [[Act.20.12|Act.20:12]], [[Rom.7.1-3|Rom.7:1-3]], [[1Co.7.39|1Co.7:39]], [[Rev.19.20|Rev.19:20]], al.; ἐν αὐτῷ ζῶμεν, [[Act.17.28|Act.17:28]] ἐμοὶ τὸ ζῆν Χριστός, [[Php.1.21|Php.1:21]] διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν (M, _Pr._, 215, 249), [[Heb.2.15|Heb.2:15]] ὃ δὲ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί, [[Gal.2.20|Gal.2:20]] ζῇ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός, [[Gal.2.20|Gal.2:20]] (ὁ) ζῶν, of God (אֵל חַי and cognate phrases, [[Jos.3.10|Jos.3:10]], [[Hos.2.1|Hos.2:1]] (1:10), [[Isa.37.4|Isa.37:4]], al.; see _DCG_, ii, 39a), [[Mat.16.16|Mat.16:16]], [[Jhn.6.57|Jhn.6:57]], [[Rom.9.26|Rom.9:26]], [[1Th.1.9|1Th.1:9]], [[Heb.3.12|Heb.3:12]], [[Rev.7.2|Rev.7:2]], al.; in juristic phrase, ζῶ ἐγώ (חַי־אָנִי, [[Num.14.21|Num.14:21]], al.), **as I live**, [[Rom.14.11|Rom.14:11]] ζῆν ἐπ᾽ ἄρτῳ, [[Mat.4.4|Mat.4:4]], al.; ἐκ, [[1Co.9.14|1Co.9:14]] of coming to life, Mrk.16:[11], [[Rom.6.10; 14.9|Rom.6:10 14:9]], [[2Co.13.4|2Co.13:4]]; opposite to νεκρός, [[Rev.1.18; 2.8|Rev.1:18 2:8]]; metaphorically, [[Luk.15.32|Luk.15:32]] ζῆν ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[Rom.6.13|Rom.6:13]] of the spiritual life of Christians, [[Luk.10.28|Luk.10:28]], [[Jhn.5.25|Jhn.5:25]], [[Rom.1.17; 8.13|Rom.1:17 8:13]]; εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, [[Jhn.6.51, 58|Jhn.6:51, 58]]; σὺν Χριστῷ, [[1Th.5.10|1Th.5:10]] ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς, [[Rev.3.1|Rev.3:1]]
2. As sometimes in cl., = βιόω, **to live, pass one's life**: [[Luk.2.36|Luk.2:36]], [[Act.26.5|Act.26:5]], [[Rom.7.9|Rom.7:9]], [[Col.2.20|Col.2:20]]; ἐν πίστει, [[Gal.2.20|Gal.2:20]] ἐν τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, [[Rom.6.2|Rom.6:2]] εὐσεβῶς, [[2Ti.3.12|2Ti.3:12]] ἀσώτως, [[Luk.15.13|Luk.15:13]] with dative (cl.), ἑαυτῳ (Field, _Notes_, 164), [[Rom.14.7|Rom.14:7]], [[2Co.5.15|2Co.5:15]]; τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, [[Luk.20.38|Luk.20:38]], [[Rom.6.10, 11|Rom.6:10, 11]] [[Gal.2.19|Gal.2:19]]; τ. Χριστῷ, [[2Co.5.15|2Co.5:15]] τ. θεῷ, [[1Pe.2.24|1Pe.2:24]] πνεύματι, [[Gal.5.25|Gal.5:25]] κατὰ σάρκα, [[Rom.8.12, 13|Rom.8:12, 13]];
3. Of inanimate things, metaphorically: ὕδωρ ζῶν (i.e. springing water, as opposite to still water), in a spiritual sense, [[Jhn.4.10, 11; 7.38|Jhn.4:10, 11 7:38]] (_DCG_, ii, 39f.): ἐλπὶς ζῶσα, [[1Pe.1.3|1Pe.1:3]] ὁδὸς ζῶσα, [[Heb.10.20|Heb.10:20]] (cf. ἀνα-, συν-ζάω; Cremer, 270, 721).
(AS)

G2194.def:
**Ζαβουλών**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְבוּלוּן see [[Gen.30.20|Gen.30:20]])
**Zebulun, Jacob's tenth son**: the tribe of Z., [[Mat.4.13, 15|Mat.4:13, 15]], [[Rev.7.8|Rev.7:8]].†
(AS)

G2132.def:
**εὐ-νοέω**, -ῶ
(εὔνοος, friendly), [in LXX: [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]] Bא1, Dan LXX 2:43, [[3Ma.7.11|3Ma.7:11]] * ;]
**to be favourable, kindly disposed**: with dative, [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]]†
(AS)

G2149.def:
**εὐρύ-χωρος**, -ον
(εὐρύς, broad + χώρα), [in LXX for רָחַב ni., and cognate forms ([[Isa.30.23|Isa.30:23]], al.), exc. [[2Ch.18.9|2Ch.18:9]] (גֹּרֶן ;)
**spacious, broad**: [[Mat.7.13|Mat.7:13]]†
(AS)

G2123.def:
**εὔ-κοπος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Sir.22.15|Sir.22:15]], [[1Ma.3.18|1Ma.3:18]] * ;]
**with easy labour, easy**: compar., -ώτερόν ἐστι, with inf., [[Mat.9.5|Mat.9:5]], [[Mrk.2.9|Mrk.2:9]], [[Luk.5.23|Luk.5:23]]; with accusative and inf., [[Mat.19.24|Mat.19:24]], [[Mrk.10.25|Mrk.10:25]], [[Luk.16.17; 18.25|Luk.16:17 18:25]] (Polyb.; the adv. -ως occurs in Aristoph., Fr., 615).†
(AS)

G2107.def:
**εὐδοκία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὐδοκέω, which see), [in LXX: [[Psa.5.12|Psa.5:12]], al. (רָצוֹן), frequently in Sir; in Inscr. (I.G., 5960), LXX, and NT = εὐδόκησις (Died.) ;]
**good pleasure, good-will, satisfaction, approval**: [[Mat.11.26|Mat.11:26]], [[Luk.10.21|Luk.10:21]], [[Rom.10.1|Rom.10:1]], [[Eph.1.5|Eph.1:5]], 9, [[Php.1.15; 2.13|Php.1:15 2:13]]; with genitive obj., [[2Th.1.11|2Th.1:11]] (see Milligan, in l); ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκία, Rec., R, mg., WH, mg. (see Field, _Notes_, 48 f.), [[Luk.2.14|Luk.2:14]] -ας, Lk, l.with, R, txt., WH, txt. (see _ICC_, in l; WH, _App._, in l).†
(AS)

G2127.def:
**εὐλογέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ pi. ;]
1. to speak well of, praise (cl.; LXX [[Deu.8.10|Deu.8:10]], al.): τ. θεόν, [[Luk.1.64; 2.28; 24.51, 53|Luk.1:64 2:28 24:51, 53]] (αἰνοῦντες, T, WH, mg.), [[Jas.3.9|Jas.3:9]] absol., to give praise, [[Mat.14.19; 26.26|Mat.14:19 26:26]] (see Swete on [[Mrk.14.22|Mrk.14:22]]), [[Mrk.6.41; 14.22|Mrk.6:41 14:22]] (see Swete, in l), [[Luk.24.30|Luk.24:30]], [[1Co.14.16|1Co.14:16]].
2. As in LXX (= בָּרַךְ pi.);
(a) to bless, invoke blessings on ([[Gen.24.60|Gen.24:60]], [[Num.23.20|Num.23:20]], al.): absol., [[1Co.4.12|1Co.4:12]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.2.34; 6.28; 24.50-51|Luk.2:34 6:28 24:50-51]], [[Rom.12.14|Rom.12:14]], [[Heb.7.1, 6-7; 11.20-21|Heb.7:1, 6-7 11:20-21]]; εὐλογημένος (= בָּרַךְ; see Lft., _Notes_, 310; _DCG_, i, 189), blessed, [[Mat.21.9; 23.39|Mat.21:9 23:39]]" (LXX), [[Mrk.11.9-10|Mrk.11:9-10]], [[Luk.13.35; 19.38|Luk.13:35 19:38]]" (LXX), [[Jhn.12.13|Jhn.12:13]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.8.7|Mrk.8:7]], [[Luk.9.16|Luk.9:16]], [[1Co.10.16|1Co.10:16]];
(b) with God as subject ([[Psa.44.3|Psa.44:3]], al.), **to bless, prosper, bestow blessings on**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.3.26|Act.3:26]], [[Gal.3.9|Gal.3:9]], [[Eph.1.3|Eph.1:3]] (Lft., _Notes_, 311), [[Heb.6.14|Heb.6:14]] εὐλογημένος, [[Luk.1.28|Luk.1:28]] (WH, tit., R, tit., omit) [[Luk.1.42|Luk.1:42]] εὐλογημένοι τ. πατρός (cf. [[Isa.61.9|Isa.61:9]]), [[Mat.25.34|Mat.25:34]]; pass. [[Act.3.25|Act.3:25]] (cf. ἐν-, κατ-ευλογέω).†
_SYN._: see: αἰνέω, and cf. _DCG_, i, 189, 211; Cremer, 766 (AS)

G2105.def:
**εὐδία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὔδιος, calm) [in LXX: [[Sir.3.15|Sir.3:15]] * ;]
**fair weather**: [[Mat.16.2|Mat.16:2]] (Rec., R, txt.).†
(AS)

G2135.def:
**εὐνοῦχος**, -ου, ὁ
(i.e. ὁ τὴν εὐνὴν(bed) ἔχων), [in LXX for סָרִיס (perhaps not of necessity an actual eunuch; _DB_, see word), [[Gen.39.1|Gen.39:1]], al., [[Wis.3.14|Wis.3:14]], [[Sir.20.4; 30.20|Sir.20:4 30:20]] ;]
**an emasculated man, a eunuch**: [[Mat.19.12|Mat.19:12]] one such holding, as was common, high office, as of chamberlain, at court, [[Act.8.27, 34-39|Act.8:27, 34-39]]; metaphorically, of one naturally incapacitated for or volun­tarily abstaining from wedlock, [[Mat.19.12|Mat.19:12]]†
(AS)

G2134.def:
**εὐνουχίζω**
(εὐνοῦχος),
**to make a eunuch of, castrate**: pass., [[Mat.19.12|Mat.19:12]] metaphorically, εὐ. έαυτόν, ib.†
(AS)

G2176.def:
**εὐώνυμος**, -ον
(εὖ, ὄνομα), [in LXX chiefly for שְׂמֹאול ;]
1. of good name or omen.
2. **Euphemistic for ἀριστερός, left**: [[Act.21.3|Act.21:3]], [[Rev.10.2|Rev.10:2]]; ἐξ εὐωνύμων, **on the left**: [[Mat.20.21, 23; 25.33, 41; 27.38|Mat.20:21, 23 25:33, 41 27:38]], [[Mrk.10.40; 15.27|Mrk.10:40 15:27]].†
(AS)

G2197.def:
**Ζαχαρίας**, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זַכַּי);
1. **Zacharias, father of John the Baptist**: [[Luk.1.5, 12-13; 1.18, 21; 1.40, 59; 1.67; 3.2|Luk.1:5, 12-13 1:18, 21 1:40, 59 1:67 3:2]].
2. Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada (in txt. wrongly called son of Barachiah; cf. [[2Ch.24.19|2Ch.24:19]] ff.): [[Mat.23.35|Mat.23:35]], [[Luk.11.51|Luk.11:51]].†
(AS)

G2120.def:
**εὐκαιρία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὔκαιρος), [in LXX: [[Psa.9.10|Psa.9:10]] (see Soph., _Lex._, see word) [[Psa.10.1; 145.15|Psa.10:1 145:15]] (עֵת), [[Sir.38.24|Sir.38:24]], [[1Ma.11.42|1Ma.11:42]] * ;]
**fitting time, opportunity**: before ἵνα, [[Mat.26.16|Mat.26:16]] τοῦ, with inf., [[Luk.22.6|Luk.22:6]]†
(AS)

G2121.def:
**εὔ-καιρος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Psa.104.27|Psa.104:27]] (עֵת), [[2Ma.14.29|2Ma.14:29]] [[2Mac.15.20-21|2Mac 15:20-21]], [[3Ma.4.11|3Ma.4:11]] [[3Mac.5.44|3Mac 5:44]] * ;]
**timely, seasonable, suitable **(Cremer, 740): ἡμέρα, [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]] (or empty, as in Byz. and M_Gr._; see MM, _Exp._, xiv); βοήθεια, [[Heb.4.16|Heb.4:16]]†
(AS)

G2119.def:
**εὐκαιρέω**, -ῶ
(= cl., εὖ σχολῆς ἔχειν; used by Polyb. and Philo; cf. Rutherford, _NPhr._ 205; MM, _Exp._, xiv),
**to have leisure or opportunity**: [[1Co.16.12|1Co.16:12]] with inf., [[Mrk.6.31|Mrk.6:31]] before εἰς, to devote one's leisure to, [[Act.17.21|Act.17:21]]†
(AS)

G2188.def:
**ἐφφαθά** (Aram. אֶתְפְּתח, see Abbott, _Essays_, 142 ff.; _DCG_, i, 522)
**ephphatha, be opened**: [[Mrk.7.34|Mrk.7:34]]†
(AS)

G2122.def:
**εὐκαίρως **
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Sir.18.22|Sir.18:22]] * ;]
**seasonably, in season**: [[Mrk.14.11|Mrk.14:11]] opposite to ἀκ- (Kühner3, iv, 346 d), [[2Ti.4.2|2Ti.4:2]]†
(AS)

G2158.def:
**εὐσχήμωι**, -ον
(εὖ, σχῆμα), [in LXX: [[Pro.11.25|Pro.11:25]] * ;]
1. **elegant, graceful, comely **(Eur., Plat., al.): τὰ εὐ. ἡμῶν (opposite to τὰ ἀσχ- ἡμ-), [[1Co.12.24|1Co.12:24]] in moral sense, seemly, becoming, [[1Co.7.35|1Co.7:35]]
2. Also in late Gk. (see Swete, _Mk._, l.with; MM, _Exp._, xiv), **wealthy, influential **(RV, of honourable estate): [[Mrk.15.43|Mrk.15:43]], [[Act.13.50; 17.12|Act.13:50 17:12]].†
(AS)

G2183.def:
**ἐφ-ημερία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἐφήμερος), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת, מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
1. a course of daily services ([[Neh.13.30|Neh.13:30]], [[1Ch.25.8|1Ch.25:8]], al.).
2. a class or course of priests detailed for service in the temple ([[1Ch.23.6|1Ch.23:6]], al.): [[Luk.1.5|Luk.1:5]], 8 (cf. M_Gr._, ἐφημέριος, priest).†
(AS)

G2126.def:
**εὐλαβής**, -ές
(εὖ, λαβεῖν), [in LXX: [[Mic.7.2|Mic.7:2]] AB2 (חָסִיד); εὐ. ποιεῖν, [[Lev.15.31|Lev.15:31]] (נָזַר hi.), [[Sir.11.7|Sir.11:7]] א2* ;]
1. cautious, circumspect.
2. **devout, religious, reverent**: [[Act.2.5; 8.2; 22.12|Act.2:5 8:2 22:12]]; δίκαιος καὶ εὐ., [[Luk.2.25|Luk.2:25]]†
(AS)

G2111.def:
**εὔ-θετος**, -ον
(τίθημι), [in LXX: [[Psa.32.6|Psa.32:6]] (מָצָא), From Th [[Sus.1.15|Sus 1:15]]* ;]
**ready for use, fit**: of things, with dative, [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]] before εἰς, [[Luk.14.35|Luk.14:35]] of persons, with dative, [[Luk.9.62|Luk.9:62]] (for rabbinic parallels, see Dalman, _Words_, 119 f.).†
(AS)

G2165.def:
**εὐφραίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂמַח, qal, pi. ;]
**to cheer, gladden**: with accusative of person(s), opposite to λυπεῖν, [[2Co.2.2|2Co.2:2]] Pass., **to be happy, rejoice, make merry**: [[Luk.15.32|Luk.15:32]], [[Act.2.26|Act.2:26]]" (LXX) [[Rom.15.10|Rom.15:10]] (LXX), [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]] (LXX), [[Rev.11.10; 12.12|Rev.11:10 12:12]]; before ἐν, [[Act.7.41|Act.7:41]] ἐπί with dative, [[Rev.18.20|Rev.18:20]] of merry-making at a feast ([[1Ki.4.20|3Ki.4:20]] of. Kennedy, _Sources_, 155; Field, _Notes_, 69 f.), [[Luk.12.19; 15.23-24, 29|Luk.12:19 15:23-24, 29]]" (LXX) (λαμπρῶς) [[Luk.16.19|Luk.16:19]]†
(AS)

G2195.def:
**Ζακχαῖος**, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זַכַּי, cf. [[Neh.7.14|Neh.7:14]], I [[Est.2.9|Est.2:9]], LXX Ζακχού),
**Zaccai, Zacchaeus, a publican**: [[Luk.19.2, 5; 19.8|Luk.19:2, 5 19:8]] (cf. [[2Ma.10.19|2Ma.10:19]]).†
(AS)

G2189.def:
**ἔχθρα**, -ας, ἡ
(ἐχθρός), [in LXX for אֵיבָה, שִׂנְאָה, etc. ;]
**enmity**: [[Luk.23.12|Luk.23:12]], [[Rom.8.7|Rom.8:7]], [[Gal.5.20|Gal.5:20]], [[Eph.2.15-16|Eph.2:15-16]], [[Jas.4.4|Jas.4:4]].†
ἀηδία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀ- neg., ἦδος, pleasure), [in LXX: [[Pro.23.29|Pro.23:29]] (שִׂיחַ)* ;]
1. of things or persons, unpleasantness, odiousness (Hipp., Dem., al.)
2. dislike (Plat.). disagreement (MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Luk.23.12|Luk.23:12]] D.†
(AS)

G2167.def:
**εὐφροσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(εὔφρων, cheerful) [in LXX chiefly for שִׂמְחָה ;]
**rejoicing, gladness**: [[Act.2.28|Act.2:28]] (LXX) [[Act.14.17|Act.14:17]]†
(AS)

G2150.def:
**εὐ-σέβεια**, -ας, ἡ
(εὐσεβής, which see), [in LXX: [[Pro.1.7|Pro.1:7]], [[Isa.33.6|Isa.33:6]] (יִרְאָה), [[Pro.13.11|Pro.13:11]] (aliter in _Heb._), [[Isa.11.2|Isa.11:2]] (יְהוָֹה יִרְאָה), I [[Est.1.23|Est.1:23]], [[Wis.10.12|Wis.10:12]], [[Sir.49.3|Sir.49:3]], and very frequently in 4Mac ;]
1. piety, reverence (towards parents and others).
2. **piety towards God, godliness**: [[Act.3.12|Act.3:12]], [[1Ti.2.2; 4.7-8; 6.5-6; 6.11|1Ti.2:2 4:7-8 6:5-6 6:11]], [[2Pe.1.3; 1.6-7|2Pe.1:3 1:6-7]]; τὸ τῆς εὐ. μυστήριον, [[1Ti.3.16|1Ti.3:16]] ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ. διδασκαλία, [[1Ti.6.3|1Ti.6:3]] ἡ ἀλήθεια ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ., [[Tit.1.1|Tit.1:1]] μόρφωσις εὐσεβείας, [[2Ti.3.5|2Ti.3:5]] pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6; Mayor on [[Jas.2.1|Jas.2:1]]), [[2Pe.3.11|2Pe.3:11]] (on the use of εὐ. and cognates in Past. Epp., see CGT, on [[1Ti.2.2|1Ti.2:2]] cf. also Cremer, 524).†
(AS)

G2108.def:
**εὐεργεσία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὐεργέτης), [in LXX: [[Psa.78.11|Psa.78:11]] (עֲלִילָה), [[Wis.16.11, 24|Wis.16:11, 24]], [[2Ma.6.13|2Ma.6:13]] [[2Mac.9.26|2Mac 9:26]], [[4Ma.8.17|4Ma.8:17]] * ;]
**a good deed, kindness, benefit**: [[1Ti.6.2|1Ti.6:2]] with genitive of person(s) (εὐ. πόλεως, Plat., leg., 805b), [[Act.4.9|Act.4:9]],†
(AS)

G2152.def:
**εὐσεβής**, -ές
(εὖ, σέβομαι), [in LXX: [[Pro.12.12|Pro.12:12]], [[Isa.24.16; 26.7|Isa.24:16 26:7]] (צַדִּיק), [[Mic.7.2|Mic.7:2]] (חָסִיד), [[Isa.32.8|Isa.32:8]] (נָדִיב), and frequently in Sirach and 4Maccabees ;]
**pious, godly, devout**: [[Act.10.2|Act.10:2]], 7, [[2Pe.2.9|2Pe.2:9]].†
_SYN._: θεοσεβής, θρῆσκος (see Tr., _Syn._, § xlviii; _DB_, ii, 221 f.; Cremer, 524 f., 858) (AS)

G2109.def:
**εὐεργετέω**, -ῶ
(εὐεργέτης), [in LXX: [[Psa.13.6|Psa.13:6]] (גָּמַל), [[Wis.3.5|Wis.3:5]], al. ;]
**to do good, bestow benefit**: [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]]†
(AS)

G2141.def:
**εὐ-πορέω**, -ῶ
(εὔτορος, well provided for) [in LXX: [[Lev.25.26, 49|Lev.25:26, 49]] נָשַׂג hi.), [[Lev.25.23|Lev.25:23]] (seel.), [[Wis.10.10|Wis.10:10]] * ;]
**to prosper, be well off**: [[Act.11.29|Act.11:29]]†
(AS)

G2113.def:
**εὐθυδρομέω**, -ῶ
**of ships, to run a straight course **(Philo): [[Act.16.11; 21.1|Act.16:11 21:1]].†
(AS)

G2151.def:
**εὐ-σεβέω**, -ῶ
(εὐσεβής, which see), [in LXX: Dan LXX [[Sus.1.64|Sus 1:64]], [[4Ma.9.6|4Ma.9:6]] אR, [[4Ma.11.5|4Ma.11:5]] [[4Mac.11.8|4Mac 11:8]] [[4Mac.11.23|4Mac 11:23]] [[4Mac.18.2|4Mac 18:2]] * ;]
**to reverence, show piety towards**; with accusative (else­where more frequently before εἰς., περί, πρός): οἶκον, [[1Ti.5.4|1Ti.5:4]] θεόν, [[Act.17.23|Act.17:23]] (Cremer, 525).†
(AS)

G2171.def:
**εὐχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(εὔχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for נָדַר ;]
1. **a prayer**: [[Jas.5.15|Jas.5:15]]
2. **a vow**: [[Act.18.18; 21.23|Act.18:18 21:23]].†
_SYN._: see: δέησις (AS)

G2177.def:
**ἐφάλλομαι **
[in LXX for צָלַח, [[1Ki.10.6; 11.6; 16.13|1Ki.10:6 11:6 16:13]] * ;]
**to leap upon**: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s) [[Act.19.16|Act.19:16]]†
(AS)

G2142.def:
**εὐ-πορία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὔπορος), [in LXX for חַיִל, [[2Ki.25.10|4Ki.25:10]] A (frequently in Aq.)* ;]
1. facility.
2. **plenty, wealth**: [[Act.19.25|Act.19:25]]†
(AS)

G2172.def:
**εὔχομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for נָדַד, also for עָתַר hi., etc. ;]
**to pray**: with accusative of thing(s), [[2Co.13.9|2Co.13:9]] with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[Act.26.29|Act.26:29]] before πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[2Co.13.7|2Co.13:7]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]], [[3Jn.2|3Jn.2]]; before ὑπέρ, [[Jas.5.16|Jas.5:16]] ηὐχόμην εἶναι (On imperfect here, see _ICC_, in l, Lft., Phm 13), [[Rom.9.3|Rom.9:3]] (Cremer, 718).†
(AS)

G2148.def:
**Εὐρ-ακύλων** (Rec. εὐροκλύδων, which see), -ωνος
(Εὖρος, the East wind, and Lat. Aquilo; Vg., Euroaquilo),
the Euraquilo, a N.E. wind (i.e. between Eurus and Aquilo): [[Act.27.14|Act.27:14]]†
**εὐρο-κλύδων** (G, εὐροκλ-), -ωνος, ὁ
(Εὖρος (seel. εὐρύς, broad), κλύδων),
**Euroclydon **(prob. a sailor's corruption of Εὐρακύλων, which see): [[Act.17.14|Act.17:14]], Rec,†
(AS)

G2114.def:
**εὐθυμέω**, -ῶ
(ὔθυμος), [in Sm.: [[Psa.32.11|Psa.32:11]], [[Pro.15.15|Pro.15:15]] * ;]
1. trans., to make cheerful (Æsch.).
2. Intrans. (Eur., Plut.; so mid. in Xen., Plat.), to be of good cheer: [[Act.27.22, 25|Act.27:22, 25]], [[Jas.5.13|Jas.5:13]].†
(AS)

G2137.def:
**εὐ-οδόω**, -ῶ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for צָלַח hi. ;]
to help on one's way (Soph., al.). Pass., to have a prosperous journey; metaphorically (Hdt., al.), **to prosper, be prospered, be successful**: [[3Jn.2|3Jn.2]], [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]], [[1Co.16.2|1Co.16:2]] (on the tense, see M, _Pr._, 54; _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G2182.def:
**ἐφ-ευρετής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐφευρίσκω, to find out)
**an inventor, contriver**: κακῶν (cf. κακίας εὑρετής, [[2Ma.7.31|2Ma.7:31]]), [[Rom.1.30|Rom.1:30]].†
(AS)

G2101.def:
**εὐ-άρεστος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Wis.4.10; 9.10|Wis.4:10 9:10]] * ;]
**well-pleasing, acceptable**: [[Rom.12.2|Rom.12:2]] with dative of person(s), [[Rom.12.1; 14.16|Rom.12:1 14:16]], [[2Co.5.9|2Co.5:9]], [[Eph.5.10|Eph.5:10]], [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]]; id. before ἐν, [[Tit.2.9|Tit.2:9]] (κυρίῳ), [[Col.3.20|Col.3:20]] ἐνώπιον, [[Heb.13.21|Heb.13:21]] (for ex. in Inser., see Deiss., BS, 215).†
(AS)

G2144.def:
**εὐ-πρόσ-δεκτος**, -ον
(εὖ, προσδέχομαι)
more usual than δέκτος, which see, **acceptable**: [[Rom.15.16, 31|Rom.15:16, 31]], [[2Co.6.2; 8.12|2Co.6:2 8:12]], [[1Pe.2.5|1Pe.2:5]].†
(AS)

G2129.def:
**εὐλογία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for בְּרָכָה ;]
1. **fair speaking, flattering speech**: χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐ., [[Rom.16.18|Rom.16:18]]
2. **praise**: of God (as in late Inscr.; LS, see word) and Christ, [[Rev.5.12-13; 7.12|Rev.5:12-13 7:12]]
3. **In LXX and NT**: blessing, benediction;
(a) **the act of blessing**: [[1Co.10.16|1Co.10:16]], [[Heb.12.17|Heb.12:17]], [[Jas.3.10|Jas.3:10]];
(b) **concrete, a blessing**: [[Rom.15.29|Rom.15:29]], [[2Co.9.5-6|2Co.9:5-6]], [[Gal.3.14|Gal.3:14]], [[Eph.1.3|Eph.1:3]], [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]] (cf. [[Deu.11.26|Deu.11:26]], [[Sir.7.32|Sir.7:32]], al.).†
(AS)

G2154.def:
**εὔσημος**, -ον
(εὖ + οῆμα, a sign) [in LXX for כֶּסֶא, [[Psa.81.3|Psa.81:3]] (-ως, from LXX 219)* ;]
1. conspicuous (cf. Ps, l.with).
2. **clear to the understanding, distinct**: [[1Co.14.9|1Co.14:9]]†
(AS)

G2175.def:
**εὐωδία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὐώδης, fragrant; ὄζω) [in LXX for נִיחוֹחַ, [[Gen.8.21|Gen.8:21]], al. (ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας); [[Sir.20.9; 24.15|Sir.20:9 24:15]], al. ;]
**fragrance**: metaphorically, Χριστοῦ εὐ,., [[2Co.2.15|2Co.2:15]] ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας (a metaphor of sacrifice, most frequently in Pent. and Ez.), [[Eph.5.2|Eph.5:2]], [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]].†
(AS)

G2162.def:
**εὐφημία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὔφημος), [in Sm.: [[Psa.42.5; 47.2; 100.2; 126.2|Psa.42:5 47:2 100:2 126:2]] * ;]
**good report, praise**: opposite to δυσφημία, [[2Co.6.8|2Co.6:8]]†
(AS)

G2185.def:
**ἐφ-ικνέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: [[Sir.43.27, 30|Sir.43:27, 30]] R (ἀφικ- ABא)* ;]
**to come to, to reach**: before ἄχρι, [[2Co.10.13|2Co.10:13]] εἰς, [[2Co.10.14|2Co.10:14]]†
(AS)

G2146.def:
**εὐ-προσωπέω**, -ῶ
(εὐπρόσωπος, fair of face), [in Al.: [[Psa.141.6|Psa.141:6]], seel. for -ίζω* ;]
**to look well, make a fair show**: metaphorically (as in 7.; see Deiss., _LAE_, 96), [[Gal.6.12|Gal.6:12]]†
(AS)

G2155.def:
**εὔσπλαγχνος**, -ον
(εὖ, σπλάγχνον, which see), [in [[Man.1.7|Man.1.7]] (Camb. Manual LXX, iii, 825) ;]
1. in Hippocr., as medical term (LS, see word).
2. Metaphorical (cf. εὐσιλαγχνία, Eurip., Rhes., 192), in NT, **tenderhearted, compassionate**: [[Eph.4.32|Eph.4:32]], [[1Pe.3.8|1Pe.3:8]].†
(AS)

G2160.def:
**εὐτραπελία**, -ας, ἡ
(εὖ, τρέπω),
1. versatility, wit, facetiousness (Hippocr., Plat., al.).
2. **= βωμολογία, coarse jesting, ribaldry **(Abbott, _Essays_, 93): [[Eph.5.4|Eph.5:4]]†
_SYN._: μωρολογία, see Tr., _Syn._, § xxxiv (AS)

G2133.def:
**εὔνοια**, -ας, ἡ
(εὔνοος), [in LXX: [[Est.2.23|Est.2:23]], al. ;]
**goodwill**: [[Eph.6.7|Eph.6:7]] (of slaves; cf. MM, _Exp._, xiv).†
(AS)

G2136.def:
**Εὐοδία** (Rec. -ωδία), -ας, ἡ
Euodia (not as AV, Euodias), **a Christian woman**: [[Php.4.2|Php.4:2]]†
(AS)

G2163.def:
**εὔφημος**, -ον
(εὖ, φήμη), [in Sm.: [[Psa.63.6|Psa.63:6]] ;]
primarily, utter­ing words or sounds of good omen, hence,
1. avoiding ill-omened words, religiously silent.
2. **fair-sounding, auspicious **(R, mg., gracious): [[Php.4.8|Php.4:8]]†
(AS)

G2170.def:
**εὐχάριστος**, -ον
(εὖ, χαρίζομαι), [in LXX for חֵן, [[Pro.11.16|Pro.11:16]] * ;]
1. = εὔχαρις, winning, gracious, agreeable (Pr, l.with).
2. **grateful, thankful**: [[Col.3.15|Col.3:15]]†
(AS)

G2130.def:
**εὐ-μετά-δοτος**, -ον
(εὖ, μεταδιδωμι),
**ready to impart**: assoc. with κοινωνικός (for the distinction between the two, see Field, _Notes_, 213; CGT, in l), [[1Ti.6.18|1Ti.6:18]]†
(AS)

G2173.def:
**εὔ-χρηστος**, -ον
(εὖ, χράομαι), [in LXX: [[Pro.31.13|Pro.31:13]] (חֵפֶץ), [[Wis.13.13|Wis.13:13]] * ;]
**useful, serviceable**: with dative of person(s), [[2Ti.2.21|2Ti.2:21]] id. before εἰς, with dative of thing(s), [[2Ti.4.11|2Ti.4:11]] opposite to ἄχρηστος, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G2118.def:
**εὐθύτης**, -ητος, ἡ
(εὐθύς), [in LXX chiefly for יֹשֶׁר, מִישׁוֹר and cognate forms ;]
**uprightness**: [[Heb.1.8|Heb.1:8]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2124.def:
**εὐλάβεια**, -ας, ἡ
(εὐλαβής), [in LXX: [[Jer.22.24|Jer.22:24]] (דְּאָגָה), [[Pro.28.14|Pro.28:14]], [[Wis.17.8|Wis.17:8]] * ;]
1. caution, discretion (Soph., Plat., al.).
2. In later Gk. (Diod., Plut., al.), **also reverence, godly fear**: [[Heb.5.7; 12.28|Heb.5:7 12:28]].†
(AS)

G2100.def:
**εὐαρεστέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ hith., [[Gen.5.22, 24|Gen.5:22, 24]], [[Psa.26.2; 56.13|Psa.26:2 56:13]], al., [[Sir.44.16|Sir.44:16]] ;]
**to be well pleasing**: τ. θεῷ (LXX, ll. with), [[Heb.11.5-6|Heb.11:5-6]] Pass., **to be well pleased**: with dative, [[Heb.13.16|Heb.13:16]]†
(AS)

G2125.def:
**εὐλαβέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: [[Pro.30.5|Pro.30:5]], [[Nam.1.7|Nam.1:7]] (חָסָה), al., for 15 different _Heb._ words in all; also [[Sir.7.29; 41.3|Sir.7:29 41:3]], al. ;]
1. **to be cautious, to beware**: [[Act.23.10|Act.23:10]] (Rec.; φοβηθείς, WH, RV).
2. **to reverence**: [[Heb.11.7|Heb.11:7]] (cf. Cremer, 388).†
(AS)

G2139.def:
**εὐ-περί-στατος**, -ον
(εὖ, περιΐστημι),
**of sins, readily besetting**: [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]] (on form and sense of the word, see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G2140.def:
**εὐ-ποιία** (Rec. -ιΐα), -ας, ἡ
1. **beneficence**, **doing good**: [[Heb.13.16|Heb.13:16]]
2. **a benefit** (FlJ, _Ant._, ii, ll, 2, al.).†
(AS)

G2143.def:
**εὐ-πρέπεια**, -ας, ἡ
(εὐπρεπής, comely), [in LXX for הָדָר, etc. ;]
**goodly appearance, comeliness**: [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]]†
(AS)

G2184.def:
**ἐφ-ήμερος**, -ον
(ἐπί, ἡμέρα),
1. lasting for a day.
2. **daily, for the day**: [[Jas.2.15|Jas.2:15]]†
(AS)

G2138.def:
**εὐ-πειθής**, ές,
(εὖ, πείθομαι), [in LXX: [[4Ma.12.6|4Ma.12:6]] AR* ;]
**ready to obey, compliant**: [[Jas.3.17|Jas.3:17]]†
(AS)
